# PatrykBochenek

Personal GitHub profile — renders at https://github.com/PatrykBochenek

This is the special `<username>/<username>` repo: the root `README.md` is shown
at the top of the profile page.

## Structure

- `README.md` — profile content (terminal-styled: hook, current work, projects, stack, contact)
- Mermaid diagrams (native GitHub rendering) show the opencode agent stack and
  the transaction-monitoring flow
